7-Zip 26.04 Extra x64, official unmodified standalone 7za.exe.
Source and source code: https://www.7-zip.org/
Redistribution license and unRAR restrictions: see the included License.txt.
NDE invokes 7-Zip as an independent subprocess; no static linking or binary changes.
Extracted unmodified from the official 7z2604-extra.7z (x64/7za.exe and License.txt).
The optional 7z.exe + 7z.dll layout is also supported.
Python libraries remain the fallback. 7za does not support RAR extraction.
